_comment: Candidate creature coats, OFF by default (scripts/creatures/creature_body.gd _apply_coat_flags). An enabled flag maps an ordinary coat's live albedo path to a graded file; an emission slot carrying the same image follows it; shiny bodies are untouched. The GPU judges an arm by flipping enabled; the graded files need an import like any new texture.
